  if(route&&!veh){
    for(const v of vehicleCandidatesAt(x,z,r+22)){
      if(v===u||v.destroyed||Math.abs(vehicleY(v)-y)>5)continue;
      if(circleVehicleOverlap(x,z,r+.25,v))return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
function enemyBodiesClear(u,x,z,hd){
  const veh=enemyIsVehicle(u),r=enemyBodyRadius(u),y=u.gy??enemyGroundAt(u,x,z),box=veh?vehicleBox(u,x,z,hd):null;
  if(box){box.w+=.5;box.d+=.5}
  for(const v of vehicleCandidatesAt(x,z,48)){
    if(v===u||v.destroyed||Math.abs(vehicleY(v)-y)>5)continue;
    if(veh?obbOverlap(box,vehicleBox(v)):circleVehicleOverlap(x,z,r+.3,v))return false;
  }
  for(const v of enemyCandidatesAt(x,z,32)){
    if(v===u||v.destroyed||enemyIsVehicle(v)||Math.abs((v.gy??enemyGroundAt(v,v.x,v.z))-y)>4)continue;
    if(veh?circleVehicleOverlap(v.x,v.z,enemyBodyRadius(v)+.3,{...u,x,z,hd}):Math.hypot(x-v.x,z-v.z)<r+enemyBodyRadius(v)+.3)return false;
  }
  return true;
}
// Sample both translation and rotation; a valid endpoint never permits a jump through a wall.
function enemySweep(u,ax,az,bx,bz,fromHd,toHd,dynamic=true,route=false){
  const angle=enemyIsVehicle(u)?wrapAngle(toHd-fromHd):0;
  const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((Math.hypot(bx-ax,bz-az)+Math.abs(angle)*enemyRouteRadius(u))/(route?1.2:.45)));
  for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){
    const t=i/n,x=ax+(bx-ax)*t,z=az+(bz-az)*t,hd=fromHd+angle*t;
    if(!enemySolidAt(u,x,z,hd,route)||(dynamic&&!enemyBodiesClear(u,x,z,hd)))return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function enemyMoveClear(u,x,z,hd){return enemySolidAt(u,x,z,hd)&&enemyBodiesClear(u,x,z,hd)}
function enemyReindex(u,oldX,oldZ){
  const before=vehicleCellKey(Math.floor(oldX/VEHICLE_CELL),Math.floor(oldZ/VEHICLE_CELL)),after=vehicleCellKey(Math.floor(u.x/VEHICLE_CELL),Math.floor(u.z/VEHICLE_CELL));
  if(before===after)return;
  for(const grid of enemyIsVehicle(u)?[enemyGrid,vehicleGrid]:[enemyGrid]){
    const bucket=grid.get(before),i=bucket?.indexOf(u)??-1;if(i>=0)bucket.splice(i,1);addVehicleToGrid(grid,u);
  }
}
// Bounded A*: conservative footprints allow every turn on the route. The direct
// movement test uses the oriented footprint, so aligned vehicles can use narrow gates.
function enemyFindPath(u,tx,tz){
  if(u.navSearch)return u.navSearch();
  const step=Math.max(2,enemyRouteRadius(u)*.7),sx=u.x,sz=u.z,dist=Math.hypot(tx-sx,tz-sz),reach=Math.min(dist,140);
  if(dist<.1)return [];
  const gx=sx+(tx-sx)*reach/dist,gz=sz+(tz-sz)*reach/dist,pad=60,
    minX=Math.min(sx,gx)-pad,maxX=Math.max(sx,gx)+pad,minZ=Math.min(sz,gz)-pad,maxZ=Math.max(sz,gz)+pad;
  const nodes=new Map(),valid=new Map(),heap=[],key=(x,z)=>x+','+z,heur=(x,z)=>Math.hypot(gx-x,gz-z);
  function push(n){heap.push(n);let i=heap.length-1;while(i){const p=(i-1)>>1;if(heap[p].f<=n.f)break;heap[i]=heap[p];i=p}heap[i]=n}
  function pop(){const top=heap[0],last=heap.pop();if(heap.length){let i=0;while(2*i+1<heap.length){let j=2*i+1;if(j+1<heap.length&&heap[j+1].f<heap[j].f)j++;if(heap[j].f>=last.f)break;heap[i]=heap[j];i=j}heap[i]=last}return top}
  const start={ix:0,iz:0,x:sx,z:sz,g:0,f:heur(sx,sz),h:heur(sx,sz)};nodes.set('0,0',start);push(start);let best=start;
  let count=0;
  const advance=()=>{
  while(heap.length&&count<1600){
    if(enemyNodeBudget<=0)return null;
    enemyNodeBudget--;count++;
    const n=pop();if(n.closed||nodes.get(key(n.ix,n.iz))!==n)continue;n.closed=true;if(n.h<best.h)best=n;
    if(n.h<step*1.2){best=n;break}
    for(const [dx,dz] of ENEMY_ASTAR_NEIGHBORS){
      const ix=n.ix+dx,iz=n.iz+dz,k=key(ix,iz),x=sx+ix*step,z=sz+iz*step,old=nodes.get(k),g=n.g+step*Math.hypot(dx,dz);
      if(x<minX||x>maxX||z<minZ||z>maxZ||old?.closed||(old&&old.g<=g))continue;
      const hd=Math.atan2(n.x-x,n.z-z);
      if(!valid.has(k))valid.set(k,enemySolidAt(u,x,z,hd,true));
      if(!valid.get(k))continue;
      const r=enemyRouteRadius(u),mx=(n.x+x)/2,mz=(n.z+z)/2,y=u.gy??enemyGroundAt(u,mx,mz);
      if((!u.basement&&treeHit(mx,mz,r))||!u.basement&&enemyGroundAt(u,mx,mz)<-.8||
         (!enemyIsVehicle(u)&&!enemySolidAt(u,mx,mz,hd,true))||
         wallCandidates(mx,mz,r+step).some(w=>!w.open&&w.playerBlock!==false&&w.y1>=y+.15&&w.y0<=y+4&&segmentAabbT(n.x,0,n.z,x,0,z,w.x0-r,w.x1+r,-1,1,w.z0-r,w.z1+r)!=null))continue;
      const h=heur(x,z),next={ix,iz,x,z,g,h,f:g+h,parent:n};nodes.set(k,next);push(next);
    }
  }
  u.navSearch=null;
  if(best===start||start.h-best.h<step*.5)return [];
  const path=[];for(let n=best;n.parent;n=n.parent)path.push({x:n.x,z:n.z});return path.reverse();
  };u.navSearch=advance;return advance();
}
function mvE(u,s,tx=u.tx,tz=u.tz){
  if(!(s>0)||!Number.isFinite(tx)||!Number.isFinite(tz))return;
  const oldHd=u.navHd??u.o.rotation.y,veh=enemyIsVehicle(u),dt=Math.min(.1,s/Math.max(.1,u.sp));
  u.navRetry=Math.max(0,(u.navRetry||0)-dt);
  const goalChanged=!u.navGoal||Math.hypot(tx-u.navGoal.x,tz-u.navGoal.z)>6;
  if(goalChanged){u.navPath=[];u.navSearch=null;u.navGoal={x:tx,z:tz};u.navRetry=0}
  let target={x:tx,z:tz},hd=Math.atan2(u.x-tx,u.z-tz);
  u.navDirectT=(u.navDirectT||0)-dt;
  if(goalChanged||u.navDirectT<=0){u.navDirect=enemySweep(u,u.x,u.z,tx,tz,oldHd,hd,false,!veh);u.navDirectT=.45}
  const direct=u.navDirect;
  if(!direct){
    if(!u.navPath?.length&&u.navRetry<=0&&enemyPathBudget>0){enemyPathBudget--;const path=enemyFindPath(u,tx,tz);if(path!==null){u.navPath=path;u.navRetry=1.2}}
    while(u.navPath?.length&&Math.hypot(u.navPath[0].x-u.x,u.navPath[0].z-u.z)<.6)u.navPath.shift();
    if(u.navPath?.length)target=u.navPath[0];else{u.hd=oldHd;return}
    hd=Math.atan2(u.x-target.x,u.z-target.z);
  }else{u.navPath=[];u.navSearch=null}
  const distance=Math.min(s,Math.hypot(target.x-u.x,target.z-u.z));
  const tryMove=(angle,length=distance,reverse=false)=>{
    // Vehicles turn at a bounded rate; reversing provides room to turn at corners.
    const nextHd=veh?(reverse?oldHd:oldHd+Math.max(-dt*1.5,Math.min(dt*1.5,wrapAngle(angle-oldHd)))):angle;
    const moveHd=veh?nextHd+(reverse?Math.PI:0):angle;
    const travel=veh&&!reverse?length*Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(wrapAngle(angle-nextHd))*2):length;
    const nx=u.x-Math.sin(moveHd)*travel,nz=u.z-Math.cos(moveHd)*travel;
    if(!enemySweep(u,u.x,u.z,nx,nz,oldHd,nextHd))return false;
    const ox=u.x,oz=u.z;u.x=nx;u.z=nz;if(!veh)u.walkY=enemyGroundAt(u,nx,nz);u.hd=nextHd;u.navHd=nextHd;enemyReindex(u,ox,oz);return true;
  };
  if(tryMove(hd)){u.navBlocked=0;return}
  // Keep a consistent passing side rather than alternately pushing into a neighbour.
  const side=u.avoidSide||1;
  for(const angle of [.45,.9,1.35])if(tryMove(hd+side*angle)||tryMove(hd-side*angle))return;
  u.hd=oldHd;u.navBlocked=(u.navBlocked||0)+dt;
  if(u.navBlocked>.6){
    if(tryMove(oldHd+Math.PI,distance*.5,true)){u.navPath=[];u.navSearch=null;u.navRetry=0}
    if(u.navBlocked>1.5){u.navPath=[];u.navRetry=0;u.avoidSide=-side;u.navBlocked=0;
      // Les rutes entre complexos no poden abandonar un tram llarg
      // pel simple fet d'haver trobat un arbre o un vehicle al camí.
      if(!u.interCompoundPatrol)u.wt=0
    }
  }
}
// Resolve invalid generated placements before play, never teleport a moving enemy.
function prepareEnemyNavigation(){return drainBuildSteps(prepareEnemyNavigationSteps())}
function* prepareEnemyNavigationSteps(){
  for(const u of E)if(u.t!=='patrulla_marina')u.o.position.set(u.x,u.gy??enemyGroundAt(u,u.x,u.z),u.z);
  rebuildVehicleGrid();
  let prepared=0;
  for(const u of E){
    yield {stage:'Navegació enemiga',completed:prepared++,total:E.length,unit:'enemics'};
    if(u.t==='torre'||u.t==='patrulla_marina')continue;
    if(!enemyMoveClear(u,u.x,u.z,u.hd)){
      const ox=u.x,oz=u.z;let found=false;
      for(let radius=2;radius<=48&&!found;radius+=2)for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
        if(i%8===0)yield {stage:'Desbloquejant emplaçaments enemics',completed:prepared,total:E.length,unit:'enemics'};
        const a=i*Math.PI/12,x=ox+Math.cos(a)*radius,z=oz+Math.sin(a)*radius;
        // El general es manté dins del seu despatx subterrani ampliat,
        // no dins l'antic rectangle de la planta superior del búnquer.
        const bunker=u.t==='general'?u.basement:null;
        if(bunker?.basement){
          const q=buildingLocalPoint(bunker,x,z),room=bunker.basement.generalRoom;
          if(room?(q.x<room.xMin||q.x>room.xMax||q.z<room.zMin||q.z>room.zMax):
            (Math.abs(q.x)>bunker.basement.halfX-1.5||
             Math.abs(q.z)>bunker.basement.halfZ-1.5))continue;
        }
        if(enemyMoveClear(u,x,z,u.hd)){u.x=x;u.z=z;enemyReindex(u,ox,oz);found=true;break}
      }
    }
    u.navHd=u.hd;u.navPath=[];u.navGoal=null;
    u.o.position.set(u.x,u.gy??enemyGroundAt(u,u.x,u.z),u.z);u.o.rotation.y=u.hd;
  }
}

;
// END src/enemy-navigation.js
// BEGIN src/marine-patrol.js
// Patrulles navals: física, IA, armes i tripulació separades de la navegació terrestre.
const MARINE_PATROL_MIN=5,MARINE_PATROL_MAX=10;
const marineAngle=a=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a),Math.cos(a));
function createMarinePatrolVisual(boat){
  // Mateix buc i cabina oberta que la llanxa pilotable.
  const metal=0x313c3d,paint=0x596b57;
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const soldier=window.HUNTER_CHARACTERS.createCommando(THREE);
    soldier.scale.setScalar(.43);soldier.position.set(side*.55,1.18,side<0?.9:1.75);
    soldier.rotation.y=side*.18;
    soldier.userData.ar.rotation.x=-.55;soldier.userData.al.rotation.x=-.72;
    boat.add(soldier);
  }
  const barrel=(root,r,length,y,z,color)=>{
    const o=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,length,8),M(color,'metal'));
    o.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;o.position.set(0,y,z);root.add(o);return o;
  };
  const createMount=(x,rocket)=>{
    const mount=new THREE.Group();
    mount.position.set(x,2.08,rocket?.1:-.4);boat.add(mount);
    bx(mount,.65,.27,.65,metal,0,0,0,'metal');
    bx(mount,rocket?.78:.4,rocket?.45:.32,.75,paint,0,.28,-.43,'paint');
    if(rocket){
      for(const off of [-.18,.18])barrel(mount,.145,1.45,.29,-1.21,metal).position.x=off;
    }else barrel(mount,.115,1.65,.29,-1.25,metal);
    const muzzle=new THREE.Object3D();
    muzzle.position.set(0,.29,rocket?-1.95:-2.075);mount.add(muzzle);
    return {mount,muzzle};
  };
  const machineGun=createMount(-.8,false),rockets=createMount(.8,true);
  boat.userData.marineWeapons={machineGun,rockets};
}
function marineSeaClear(x,z,r=10){
  return Math.abs(x)<H-28&&Math.abs(z)<H-28&&
    hAt(x,z)<-3.3&&hAt(x+r*.65,z)<-2.7&&hAt(x-r*.65,z)<-2.7&&
    hAt(x,z+r*.65)<-2.7&&hAt(x,z-r*.65)<-2.7;
}
function marineTrafficClear(u,x,z,margin=23){
  for(const v of vehicleCandidatesAt(x,z,margin+22)){
    if(v===u||v.destroyed)continue;
    const r=vehicleRadius(vehicleHitType(v.t));
    if(Math.hypot(v.x-x,v.z-z)<margin+r*.55)return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function marinePickWaypoint(u){
  // Patrulla d'una badia a una altra; mai no triem rumbs terrestres.
  for(let i=0;i<28;i++){
    const a=R()*Math.PI*2,d=130+R()*390,
          x=u.home.x+Math.cos(a)*d,z=u.home.z+Math.sin(a)*d;
    if(marineSeaClear(x,z,12)){u.tx=x;u.tz=z;u.wt=12+R()*12;return}
  }
  u.tx=u.home.x;u.tz=u.home.z;u.wt=8;
}
function spawnMarinePatrols(){return drainBuildSteps(spawnMarinePatrolsSteps())}
function* spawnMarinePatrolsSteps(){
  // Llocs deterministes per llavor: el cercador calcula el mateix mapa
  // sense haver de construir geometries, tripulació ni IA.
  const count=MARINE_PATROL_MIN+Math.floor(R()*(MARINE_PATROL_MAX-MARINE_PATROL_MIN+1));
  const starts=islands.slice().sort(()=>R()-.5),spots=[];
  const place=(x,z,hd)=>{
    if(!marineSeaClear(x,z,13)||
       spots.some(p=>Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z)<130)||
       V.some(v=>Math.hypot(v.x-x,v.z-z)<vehicleRadius(v.t)+20))return false;
    spots.push({t:'patrulla_marina',x,z,hd});
    return true;
  };
  for(let pass=0;pass<5&&spots.length<count;pass++)for(const island of starts){
    if(spots.length>=count)break;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<24;attempt++){
      if(attempt%8===0)yield {stage:'Emplaçant patrulles navals',completed:spots.length,total:count,unit:'patrulles'};
      const a=R()*Math.PI*2,dist=island.r*(1.05+R()*.65)+30,
            x=island.x+Math.cos(a)*dist,z=island.z+Math.sin(a)*dist;
      if(place(x,z,a+Math.PI/2))break;
    }
  }
  // Zones de mar obert: evita quedarnos sense patrulles en llavors
  // amb costes estretes. No acceptam ni aigua poc profunda ni solapaments.
  for(let attempt=0;spots.length<count&&attempt<3500;attempt++){
    if(attempt%16===0)yield {stage:'Mar obert per a les patrulles',completed:spots.length,total:count,unit:'patrulles'};
    const x=(R()*2-1)*(H-65),z=(R()*2-1)*(H-65);
    place(x,z,R()*Math.PI*2);
  }
  world.userData.marinePatrolPositions=spots;
  world.userData.marinePatrols={target:count,spawned:spots.length};
  if(seedSearchMode)return spots;
  for(const p of spots){
    yield {stage:'Construint patrulles navals',completed:null,total:spots.length};
    const u=mkEn('patrulla_marina',p.x,p.z);
    u.hd=p.hd;u.navHd=p.hd;u.home={x:p.x,z:p.z};u.speed=12+R()*5;
    u.yawRate=0;u.orbitSign=R()<.5?-1:1;
    u.mgCd=.8+R();u.rocketCd=3+R()*3;
    u.o.position.set(p.x,wy(p.x,p.z,0)+.2,p.z);u.o.rotation.y=p.hd;
    marinePickWaypoint(u);
  }
  return spots;
}
function marineAimGun(u,weapon,target,dt){
  const root=u.o,mount=weapon.mount;
  root.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
  const origin=weapon.muzzle.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const worldDir=new THREE.Vector3(target.x-origin.x,target.y-origin.y,target.z-origin.z);
  const local=worldDir.clone().applyQuaternion(root.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion()).invert());
  const wanted=Math.atan2(-local.x,-local.z),
        elevation=Math.max(-.45,Math.min(1.45,Math.atan2(local.y,Math.hypot(local.x,local.z)))),
        diff=marineAngle(wanted-mount.rotation.y);
  mount.rotation.y+=Math.max(-1.9*dt,Math.min(1.9*dt,diff));
  // La metralladora i el llançacoets també s'inclinen cap a un helicòpter
  // que vola per damunt, no només giren horitzontalment.
  mount.rotation.x+=Math.max(-1.25*dt,Math.min(1.25*dt,elevation-mount.rotation.x));
  root.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
  return Math.abs(marineAngle(wanted-mount.rotation.y))<.16&&
    Math.abs(elevation-mount.rotation.x)<.16;
}
function marineFire(u,weapon,target,heavy){
  const p=weapon.muzzle.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3()),
        dy=target.y-p.y+rn(-1,1)*(DIF<=.6?11:DIF<1?3:1),
        dx=target.x-p.x+rn(-1,1)*(DIF<=.6?(heavy?23:18):DIF<1?7:2),dz=target.z-p.z+rn(-1,1)*(DIF<=.6?(heavy?23:18):DIF<1?7:2),
        n=Math.max(.01,Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz));
  if(!weaponAimClear(p.x,p.y,p.z,target.x,target.y,target.z))return false;
  // Les costes i els turons també intercepten el foc disparat des del mar.
  for(let i=1;i<8;i++){
    const k=i/8,x=p.x+(target.x-p.x)*k,z=p.z+(target.z-p.z)*k,
          y=p.y+(target.y-p.y)*k;
    if(hAt(x,z)>y-.35)return false;
  }
  const speed=heavy?75:125;
  shoot(p.x,p.y,p.z,dx/n,dy/n,dz/n,speed,
    heavy?COMBAT_BALANCE.weapons.boatRocket:COMBAT_BALANCE.weapons.rifle,heavy?8:0,'e',heavy?mS:mW,heavy?2:SMALL_ARMS_SCALE,u);
  if(heavy){
    // A 245 m un coet lent necessita més de 4 segons. El TTL genèric
    // de 2.2 s l'eliminava molt abans d'arribar a la diana.
    Pj[Pj.length-1].life=Math.max(2.2,n/(speed*HEAVY_SHOT_SPEED_FACTOR)+.75);
  }
  return true;
}
function updateMarinePatrol(u,dt){
  const q=cv||P,targetY=cv?cv.o.position.y+(VT[cv.t]?.m==='a'?2:1.6):P.y+1.45,
        distance=Math.hypot(q.x-u.x,q.z-u.z);
  // Lluny de la càmera n'hi ha prou amb 10 actualitzacions/s.
  u.marineAcc=(u.marineAcc||0)+dt;
  if(distance>700&&u.marineAcc<.1)return;
  dt=Math.min(.12,u.marineAcc);u.marineAcc=0;
  // El test de visió només es recalcula cada 0,25 s: evita escanejar
  // centenars de punts costaners a cada fotograma.
  u.marineSightT=(u.marineSightT||0)-dt;
  if(u.marineSightT<=0){
    u.marineSightT=.25;
    // Contra aeronaus, la línia de visió és tridimensional: una
    // paret a la costa no ha de tapar un helicòpter que hi passa per damunt.
    const aerial=!!cv&&VT[cv.t]?.m==='a';
    u.marineVisible=distance<470&&(aerial
      ?weaponAimClear(u.x,u.o.position.y+3,u.z,q.x,targetY,q.z)
      :sight(u.x,u.z,q.x,q.z,u.o.position.y+3));
  }
  const hostile=!cheats.invisible&&!disg&&!over&&distance<470&&!!u.marineVisible;
  u.wt-=dt;u.mgCd-=dt;u.rocketCd-=dt;
  if(!Number.isFinite(u.tx)||u.wt<=0||Math.hypot(u.tx-u.x,u.tz-u.z)<35)marinePickWaypoint(u);
  let goalX=u.tx,goalZ=u.tz;
  if(hostile){
    if(distance>165){goalX=q.x;goalZ=q.z}
    else{
      // Aproximació tangencial, mantenint distància per poder disparar.
      const radialX=(u.x-q.x)/Math.max(1,distance),
            radialZ=(u.z-q.z)/Math.max(1,distance);
      goalX=q.x+radialX*135-radialZ*u.orbitSign*150;
      goalZ=q.z+radialZ*135+radialX*u.orbitSign*150;
    }
  }
  const wanted=Math.atan2(u.x-goalX,u.z-goalZ);
  let best=wanted,bestScore=Infinity,open=false;
  // Estudiem un ventall de rumbs sense girar instantàniament la llanxa.
  for(const offset of [0,.27,-.27,.55,-.55,.9,-.9,1.35,-1.35,Math.PI]){
    const hd=marineAngle(wanted+offset),fx=-Math.sin(hd),fz=-Math.cos(hd);
    const safe=marineSeaClear(u.x+fx*36,u.z+fz*36,11)&&
      marineSeaClear(u.x+fx*69,u.z+fz*69,11)&&
      marineTrafficClear(u,u.x+fx*34,u.z+fz*34,17);
    if(!safe)continue;
    const score=Math.abs(marineAngle(hd-wanted))*.8+
      Math.abs(marineAngle(hd-u.hd))*.55;
    if(score<bestScore){bestScore=score;best=hd;open=true}
  }
  if(!open){
    // Costa al davant: primer reduir marxa i descriure una corba ampla.
    best=marineAngle(u.hd+u.orbitSign*1.25);
    if(u.wt>2)u.wt=2;
  }
  const steer=marineAngle(best-u.hd),
        maxYaw=u.speed>12?.27:.39,
        desiredYaw=Math.max(-maxYaw,Math.min(maxYaw,steer*1.1));
  u.yawRate=(u.yawRate||0)+(desiredYaw-(u.yawRate||0))*(1-Math.exp(-2.3*dt));
  u.hd=marineAngle(u.hd+u.yawRate*dt);
  const bowX=-Math.sin(u.hd),bowZ=-Math.cos(u.hd),
        nextSpeed=open?(Math.abs(steer)>.75?9:hostile?20:17):2.5;
  u.speed+=(nextSpeed-u.speed)*(1-Math.exp(-1.15*dt));
  const nx=u.x+bowX*u.speed*dt,nz=u.z+bowZ*u.speed*dt;
  if(marineSeaClear(nx,nz,10)&&marineTrafficClear(u,nx,nz,16)){
    const ox=u.x,oz=u.z;u.x=nx;u.z=nz;enemyReindex(u,ox,oz);
  }else{
    u.speed=Math.max(0,u.speed-13*dt);
    u.wt=Math.min(u.wt,.5);
  }
  u.o.position.set(u.x,wy(u.x,u.z,elapsed)+.2,u.z);
  const wave=Math.sin(elapsed*2+u.x*.03+u.z*.024);
  u.o.rotation.set(wave*.028,u.hd,-u.yawRate*.12+wave*.024,'YXZ');
  const weapons=u.o.userData.marineWeapons;
  if(!hostile||distance>245)return;
  const target=new THREE.Vector3(q.x,targetY,q.z);
  const gunAligned=marineAimGun(u,weapons.machineGun,target,dt);
  const rocketAligned=marineAimGun(u,weapons.rockets,target,dt);
  if(distance<170&&gunAligned&&u.mgCd<=0&&marineFire(u,weapons.machineGun,target,false))u.mgCd=.28+rn(0,.15);
  if(distance<245&&rocketAligned&&u.rocketCd<=0&&marineFire(u,weapons.rockets,target,true))u.rocketCd=4.4+rn(0,1.8);
}

;
// END src/marine-patrol.js
// BEGIN src/enemy-ai.js
const ENEMY_SENSE_DT=.1;
const SOLDIER_MEMORY=9,SOLDIER_RETREAT=9,SOLDIER_IDEAL=17,SOLDIER_FIRE_RANGE=125;
const STEALTH=window.HUNTER_STEALTH;
const soldierReservations=new Map(),soldierReservationGrid=new Map(),soldierDoorQueues=new Map();
let soldierCoordinationTime=0;
const soldierReservationKey=(x,z)=>Math.floor(x/12)+','+Math.floor(z/12);
function releaseSoldierReservation(u){
  const old=soldierReservations.get(u);if(!old)return;
  const bucket=soldierReservationGrid.get(old.key);bucket?.delete(u);
  if(!bucket?.size)soldierReservationGrid.delete(old.key);
  soldierReservations.delete(u);
}
function reserveSoldierGoal(u,goal){
  releaseSoldierReservation(u);
  const key=soldierReservationKey(goal.x,goal.z),entry={x:goal.x,z:goal.z,key,until:soldierCoordinationTime+1.4};
  soldierReservations.set(u,entry);
  let bucket=soldierReservationGrid.get(key);if(!bucket)soldierReservationGrid.set(key,bucket=new Set());
  bucket.add(u);return goal;
}
function soldierPositionPenalty(u,x,z){
  let cost=0,checked=0;
  const cx=Math.floor(x/VEHICLE_CELL),cz=Math.floor(z/VEHICLE_CELL);
  outer:for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(let dz=-1;dz<=1;dz++){
    for(const other of enemyGrid.get(vehicleCellKey(cx+dx,cz+dz))||[]){
      if(++checked>24)break outer;
      if(other===u||other.t!=='soldat'||other.hp<=0||Math.abs(enemyGroundAt(other,other.x,other.z)-enemyGroundAt(u,x,z))>4)continue;
      const d=Math.hypot(x-other.x,z-other.z);if(d<7)cost+=(7-d)*4;
    }
  }
  checked=0;const rx=Math.floor(x/12),rz=Math.floor(z/12);
  outer:for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(let dz=-1;dz<=1;dz++){
    for(const other of soldierReservationGrid.get((rx+dx)+','+(rz+dz))||[]){
      if(++checked>24)break outer;
      const goal=soldierReservations.get(other);
      if(other===u||!goal||goal.until<soldierCoordinationTime||other.hp<=0)continue;
      const d=Math.hypot(x-goal.x,z-goal.z);if(d<8)cost+=(8-d)*10;
    }
  }
  return cost;
}
function releaseSoldierEntry(u){
  const door=u.entryDoor,queue=soldierDoorQueues.get(door);
  if(queue){queue.queue=queue.queue.filter(entry=>entry.unit!==u);if(!queue.queue.length)soldierDoorQueues.delete(door)}
  u.entryDoor=null;u.entryBuilding=null;u.entryPhase=0;u.entryWaiting=null;
}
function resetSoldierCoordination(){
  const units=new Set(E);
  for(const u of soldierReservations.keys())units.add(u);
  for(const queue of soldierDoorQueues.values())for(const entry of queue.queue)units.add(entry.unit);
  for(const u of units)if(u.t==='soldat'){
    u.tacticGoal=null;u.tacticT=0;u.tacticMode=null;u.entryDoor=null;u.entryBuilding=null;
    u.entryPhase=0;u.entryWaiting=null;u.doorRetryUntil=0;
  }
  soldierReservations.clear();soldierReservationGrid.clear();soldierDoorQueues.clear();soldierCoordinationTime=0;
}
function soldierCoordinationTick(dt){
  soldierCoordinationTime+=Math.max(0,dt);
  for(const [u,goal] of soldierReservations)if(u.hp<=0||u.destroyed||goal.until<soldierCoordinationTime||!u.canSee&&u.aiMode!=='combat')releaseSoldierReservation(u);
  for(const [door,queue] of soldierDoorQueues){
    for(const entry of [...queue.queue]){
      const u=entry.unit;
      if(u.hp<=0||u.destroyed||u.aiMode==='patrol'||door.locked||
        soldierCoordinationTime-entry.touched>.35)releaseSoldierEntry(u);
    }
    const holder=queue.queue[0];
    if(holder?.owner&&(soldierCoordinationTime-holder.progress>2.2||soldierCoordinationTime-holder.granted>8)){
      holder.unit.doorRetryUntil=soldierCoordinationTime+1.2;releaseSoldierEntry(holder.unit);
    }
    if(!queue.queue.length)soldierDoorQueues.delete(door);
  }
}
function soldierKnownBuilding(target,targetY){
  return buildingCandidates(target.x,target.z).find(b=>!b.rb&&Math.abs(target.x-b.x)<b.w/2&&
    Math.abs(target.z-b.z)<b.d/2&&targetY>b.fy-2&&targetY<b.fy+b.h+.5)||null;
}
// Visió i escolta comparteixen la posició tridimensional, però no l'estat:
// sentir un tret només dóna una darrera posició aproximada a investigar.
function soldierVisualContact(u,target,targetY,d){
  const eyeY=u.o.position.y+2.2,
        crouched=!!playerCrouched&&!cv,
        range=STEALTH.CONFIG.sightRange*(u.elite?1.30:1)*
          (crouched?STEALTH.CONFIG.crouchVisibility:1)*
          ((disg&&!cv)?0.35:1),
        targetEye=targetY+(crouched?1.25:1.5),
        // No podem fer servir hAt() sota terra: retornaria l'altura
        // de la muntanya i faria invisibles els objectius a 30 metres.
        sameBasement=!!u.basement&&targetY<u.basement.fy-3.9&&
          eyeY<u.basement.fy-3.9;
  const dx=target.x-u.x,dz=target.z-u.z,
        facing=(-Math.sin(u.hd)*dx-Math.cos(u.hd)*dz)/Math.max(.01,d),
        // L'elit té un camp visual més ample als passadissos il·luminats,
        // però les parets continuen tallant completament la visió.
        eliteAwareness=u.elite&&sameBasement&&
          (d<7||facing>Math.cos(80*Math.PI/180))&&
          Math.abs(targetEye-eyeY)<8;
  if(over||d>range||!(eliteAwareness||
    STEALTH.inView(u.hd,dx,targetEye-eyeY,dz,range)))return false;
  if(!soldierClearShot(u,u.x,u.z,eyeY,target,targetY-(crouched?.25:0)))return false;
  // A diferència de sight(), el pendent també tapa un enemic al darrere
  // d'una cresta (sense fer raycasts de geometria per cada soldat).
  if(!sameBasement){
    const steps=Math.min(32,Math.ceil(d/3));
    for(let i=1;i<steps;i++){
      const q=i/steps,x=u.x+(target.x-u.x)*q,z=u.z+(target.z-u.z)*q;
      if(hAt(x,z)>eyeY+(targetEye-eyeY)*q-.1)return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
function soldierInvestigate(u,target,dt,speed=1){
  const dist=Math.hypot(target.x-u.x,target.z-u.z);
  if(dist>3){
    mvE(u,u.sp*speed*dt,target.x,target.z);
    u.hd=Math.atan2(u.x-target.x,u.z-target.z);
    return false;
  }
  u.hd+=dt*.8;
  return true;
}
function soldierWarnNeighbors(witness,target,targetY){
  // El crit és un esdeveniment sonor: els aliats dins del cercle l'investiguen.
  // Evitem repetir-lo constantment mentre el mateix soldat manté contacte.
  const event=STEALTH.emit('alert',witness.x,witness.o.position.y+2,witness.z);
  if(event)witness.heardId=event.id;
  snd('alert',.65,{x:witness.x,y:witness.o.position.y+2,z:witness.z},witness);
  // Radio supplements a real witnessed contact; the local shout always remains.
  radioRelay.warn(witness,target,targetY,{enemies:E,active:!!started&&!paused&&!over});
}
// Punteria per dificultat. DIF=1.5 conserva exactament la dispersió antiga.
// Normal (1) falla més i Fàcil (.6) encara més, sense alterar el dany ni la IA.
function enemyAimSpread(){
  const difficulty=Math.max(.6,Math.min(1.5,DIF));
  return difficulty>=1 ? 1+(1.5-difficulty)*2.4 : 2.2+(1-difficulty)*5.5;
}
function enemyShotDirection(u,target,targetY,eyeY,roll=rn){
  const spread=enemyAimSpread();
  // Els canons explosius han de poder errar també fora del radi d'explosió.
  const explosiveBoost=u.spl?1+Math.min(1,u.spl/8)*(spread-1)*.5:1;
  const horizontal=1.5*spread*explosiveBoost,
        vertical=.85*(spread-1),
        dx=target.x-u.x+roll(-horizontal,horizontal),
         dy=targetY+(!cv&&playerCrouched?1.25:1.5)-eyeY+(vertical>0?roll(-vertical,vertical):0),
        dz=target.z-u.z+roll(-horizontal,horizontal),
        length=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz);
  return [dx/length,dy/length,dz/length];
}

// El contacte visual i la possibilitat de disparar no són el mateix.
// Les parets i els vehicles aparcats obliguen el soldat a canviar d'angle.
function soldierClearShot(u,x,z,y,target,targetY){
  const tx=target.x,tz=target.z,ty=targetY+1.5,
        reach=Math.hypot(tx-x,tz-z)/2+3,mx=(x+tx)/2,mz=(z+tz)/2;
  for(const w of wallCandidates(mx,mz,reach)){
    if(w.open||w.barbed)continue;
    const t=segmentAabbT(x,y,z,tx,ty,tz,w.x0,w.x1,w.y0,w.y1,w.z0,w.z1);
    if(t!=null&&t<.97)return false;
  }
  for(const b of buildingCandidates(mx,mz,reach)){
    if(b.rhp<=0)continue;
    const t=b.hangar
      ?hangarRoofSegmentT(x,y,z,tx,ty,tz,b)
      :segmentAabbT(x,y,z,tx,ty,tz,b.x-b.w/2-.6,b.x+b.w/2+.6,
        b.fy+b.h-.4,b.fy+b.h+1.4,b.z-b.d/2-.6,b.z+b.d/2+.6);
    if(t!=null&&t<.97)return false;
  }
  for(const v of vehicleCandidatesAt(mx,mz,reach+18)){
    if(v===cv||v.destroyed)continue; // no ens bloqueja el vehicle objectiu
    const radius=vehicleRadius(v.t)*.55,vy=vehicleY(v)+Math.min(1.7,radius*.6);
    const t=segmentSphereT(x,y,z,tx,ty,tz,v.x,vy,v.z,radius);
    if(t!=null&&t<.97)return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function soldierFlankPosition(u,target,targetY){
  const dx=target.x-u.x,dz=target.z-u.z,d=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dz)),
        fx=dx/d,fz=dz/d,sideX=-fz,sideZ=fx,
        prefer=u.avoidSide||1;
  let best=null,bestScore=Infinity;
  for(const side of [prefer,-prefer])for(const lateral of [7,13,22]){
    for(const forward of [4,11]){
      const x=u.x+side*sideX*lateral+fx*forward,z=u.z+side*sideZ*lateral+fz*forward;
      if(!enemySolidAt(u,x,z,u.hd,true))continue;
      if(!soldierClearShot(u,x,z,enemyGroundAt(u,x,z)+2.2,target,targetY))continue;
      const score=lateral+forward*.5+(side===prefer?0:4)+soldierPositionPenalty(u,x,z);
      if(score<bestScore){bestScore=score;best={x,z}}
    }
  }
  // Si encara no hi ha una línia de tir clara, avancem lateralment fins a
  // passar la vora de l'obstacle; mvE/A* decideix com rodejar-lo.
  return reserveSoldierGoal(u,best||{
    x:u.x+sideX*prefer*13+fx*9,
    z:u.z+sideZ*prefer*13+fz*9
  });
}
// Quan el jugador es refugia a dins, el soldat ha de trobar el portal
// d'entrada, creuar-lo i només llavors buscar una posició de tir.
function soldierEnterBuilding(u,b,target,dt,targetY=u.lastSeenY??u.o.position.y){
  const door=b?.door;
  if(!door||door.locked||door.bunkerGate||b.hangar){
    releaseSoldierEntry(u);return false;
  }
  const inside=Math.abs(u.x-b.x)<b.w/2-1.15&&
               Math.abs(u.z-b.z)<b.d/2-1.15;
  if(inside){
    releaseSoldierEntry(u);
    if(soldierChangeFloor(u,b,dt,targetY))return true;
    return false;
  }
  // Dos trams amb memòria: aproximació per fora i pas cap a dins.
  // Sense retenir la fase, en allunyar-se 1 m del punt exterior el soldat
  // tornava enrere i quedava oscil·lant just davant del llindar.
  if(u.entryBuilding!==b){releaseSoldierEntry(u);u.entryBuilding=b;u.entryPhase=0}
  let queue=soldierDoorQueues.get(door);
  if(!queue){if(soldierDoorQueues.size>=64)return false;soldierDoorQueues.set(door,queue={queue:[]})}
  let entry=queue.queue.find(item=>item.unit===u);
  if(!entry&&soldierCoordinationTime>=(u.doorRetryUntil||0)&&queue.queue.length<8){
    entry={unit:u,touched:soldierCoordinationTime,progress:soldierCoordinationTime,
      granted:soldierCoordinationTime,x:u.x,z:u.z};queue.queue.push(entry);u.entryDoor=door;
  }
  if(entry)entry.touched=soldierCoordinationTime;
  const index=entry?queue.queue.indexOf(entry):8;
  if(index!==0){
    const rank=Math.max(1,index),side=rank%2?1:-1,
      waiting={x:door.cx+door.nx*(5.5+Math.floor((rank-1)/2)*3.2)+door.nz*side*3.3,
        z:door.cz+door.nz*(5.5+Math.floor((rank-1)/2)*3.2)-door.nx*side*3.3};
    u.entryWaiting=waiting;u.entryPhase=0;
    if(Math.hypot(u.x-waiting.x,u.z-waiting.z)>.4)mvE(u,u.sp*.75*dt,waiting.x,waiting.z);
    return true;
  }
  if(!entry.owner){entry.owner=true;entry.granted=entry.progress=soldierCoordinationTime;entry.x=u.x;entry.z=u.z}
  if(Math.hypot(u.x-entry.x,u.z-entry.z)>.35){entry.x=u.x;entry.z=u.z;entry.progress=soldierCoordinationTime}
  u.entryWaiting=null;
  const exterior={x:door.cx+door.nx*2.1,z:door.cz+door.nz*2.1},
        interior={x:door.cx-door.nx*2.5,z:door.cz-door.nz*2.5},
        distance=Math.hypot(u.x-exterior.x,u.z-exterior.z);
  // Primer arribam al centre exacte del portal: les portes de 2,5 m
  // tenen poc marge amb el radi conservador de l'A*. Des d'aquest punt
  // el trajecte cap a dins és perpendicular a la paret, sense enganxar-se.
  // El pas no exigeix encertar un punt de 6,5 cm: amb A*, separació entre
  // soldats i passos discrets es poden fer oscil·lacions a l'exterior.
  // Un radi lligat al pas del fotograma permet superar el llindar sense
  // canviar de fase prematurament des de les cantonades de la paret.
  const entryTolerance=Math.max(.35,Math.min(.95,u.sp*dt*1.25));
  const lateral=Math.abs((u.x-door.cx)*door.nz-(u.z-door.cz)*door.nx);
  if(u.entryPhase===0&&distance<=entryTolerance&&lateral<=.025){
    u.entryPhase=1;u.navDirectT=0;u.navGoal=null;u.navPath=[];u.navSearch=null;
  }
  const goal=u.entryPhase?interior:exterior;
  u.tacticGoal=null;u.tacticT=0;
  releaseSoldierReservation(u);
  mvE(u,u.sp*dt,goal.x,goal.z);
  u.hd=Math.atan2(u.x-target.x,u.z-target.z);
  return true;
}
function soldierFirePosition(u,target,targetY,d){
  const base=Math.atan2(u.x-target.x,u.z-target.z),prefer=u.avoidSide||1,
    radius=d<SOLDIER_RETREAT?15:d>17?16:13;
  let best=null,score=Infinity;
  for(const offset of [0,.3*prefer,-.3*prefer,.6*prefer,-.6*prefer,.95*prefer,-.95*prefer]){
    const a=base+offset,x=target.x+Math.sin(a)*radius,z=target.z+Math.cos(a)*radius;
    if(!enemySolidAt(u,x,z,u.hd,true)||!soldierClearShot(u,x,z,enemyGroundAt(u,x,z)+2.2,target,targetY))continue;
    const value=Math.hypot(x-u.x,z-u.z)*.3+Math.abs(offset)*2+soldierPositionPenalty(u,x,z);
    if(value<score){score=value;best={x,z}}
  }
  return reserveSoldierGoal(u,best||{x:u.x,z:u.z});
}
function soldierEngage(u,target,targetY,dt,d,visible){
  const eyeY=u.o.position.y+2.2,clear=visible&&u.canShoot;
  let goal=null,speed=u.sp;
  const tacticMode=clear?'fire':'flank';
  if(u.tacticMode!==tacticMode){u.tacticGoal=null;u.tacticT=0;u.tacticMode=tacticMode}
  if(!clear){
    if(!u.tacticGoal||(u.tacticT||0)<=0||
       Math.hypot(target.x-(u.tacticTargetX??target.x),target.z-(u.tacticTargetZ??target.z))>7||
       Math.hypot(u.tacticGoal.x-u.x,u.tacticGoal.z-u.z)<2){
      u.tacticGoal=soldierFlankPosition(u,target,targetY);
      u.tacticTargetX=target.x;u.tacticTargetZ=target.z;u.tacticT=.85;
    }
    goal=u.tacticGoal;speed=u.sp*.95;
  }else{
    if(!u.tacticGoal||(u.tacticT||0)<=0||Math.hypot(target.x-(u.tacticTargetX??target.x),target.z-(u.tacticTargetZ??target.z))>7){
      u.tacticGoal=soldierFirePosition(u,target,targetY,d);u.tacticT=1.1;
      u.tacticTargetX=target.x;u.tacticTargetZ=target.z;
    }
    goal=u.tacticGoal;speed=u.sp*(d<SOLDIER_RETREAT?.87:d>SOLDIER_IDEAL?1:.55);
  }
  if(goal)mvE(u,speed*dt,goal.x,goal.z);
  const toward=target;
  u.hd=Math.atan2(u.x-toward.x,u.z-toward.z); // la cara sempre al jugador
}

// Les defenses utilitzen el canó pesat contra qualsevol vehicle i
// el fusell lleuger contra el jugador a peu, sense nivells de blindatge.
function towerWeaponForTarget(vehicle){
  return vehicle?'heavy':'light';
}
// El fusell de l'artiller gira des de la finestra dreta del cotxe.
// El marcador és fill de la boca del canó visible: l'origen del tret
// segueix sempre el model real i no el centre del vehicle.
function enemyCarRifleShot(u,target,targetY){
  const crew=u.o.userData.enemyCarCrew;
  if(!crew)return null;
  u.o.position.set(u.x,(u.gy??enemyGroundAt(u,u.x,u.z))+.05,u.z);
  u.o.rotation.y=u.navHd??u.hd;
  u.o.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const spread=enemyAimSpread(),horizontal=1.5*spread,vertical=.85*(spread-1),
         aim=new THREE.Vector3(target.x+rn(-horizontal,horizontal),
           targetY+(!cv&&playerCrouched?1.25:1.5)+(vertical?rn(-vertical,vertical):0),target.z+rn(-horizontal,horizontal));
  u.o.worldToLocal(aim);
  const dx=aim.x-crew.mount.position.x,dy=aim.y-crew.mount.position.y,
        dz=aim.z-crew.mount.position.z;
  crew.mount.rotation.y=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz);
  crew.pitch.rotation.x=Math.max(-.7,Math.min(.75,Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz))));
  u.o.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  return {origin:crew.muzzle.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3()),
    direction:new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1).applyQuaternion(
      crew.muzzle.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion())).normalize()};
}
// Les ones explosives no poden impulsar una unitat a través de parets.
// Especialment, el general no pot sortir del seu despatx subterrani.
function moveBlastedEnemy(u,dt){
  const imp=u.blastImpulse,dx=imp.vx*dt,dz=imp.vz*dt,
        room=u.t==='general'?u.basement?.basement?.generalRoom:null;
  const clear=(x,z)=>{
    if(room){
      const p=buildingLocalPoint(u.basement,x,z),margin=.35;
      if(p.x<room.xMin+margin||p.x>room.xMax-margin||
         p.z<room.zMin+margin||p.z>room.zMax-margin)return false;
    }
    return enemySolidAt(u,x,z,u.hd);
  };
  const ox=u.x,oz=u.z,steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(dx,dz)/.45));
  for(let i=0;i<steps;i++){
    const sx=dx/steps,sz=dz/steps;
    if(clear(u.x+sx,u.z+sz)){u.x+=sx;u.z+=sz;continue}
    if(clear(u.x+sx,u.z)){u.x+=sx;imp.vz=0;continue}
    if(clear(u.x,u.z+sz)){u.z+=sz;imp.vx=0;continue}
    imp.vx=imp.vz=0;break;
  }
  if(u.x!==ox||u.z!==oz)enemyReindex(u,ox,oz);
}
function updEn(dt,preserveFrameBudget=false){if(!preserveFrameBudget){enemyPathBudget=2;enemyNodeBudget=160}refreshVehicleGridIfCellsChanged();soldierCoordinationTick(dt);E.forEach(u=>{
  if(u.t==='patrulla_marina'){updateMarinePatrol(u,dt);return}
  if(u.blastT>0){
    const imp=u.blastImpulse;u.blastT=Math.max(0,u.blastT-dt);
    if(imp){
      moveBlastedEnemy(u,dt);
      imp.vy-=19*dt;
      u.blastHeight=Math.max(0,(u.blastHeight||0)+imp.vy*dt);
      // El forjat del soterrani és un límit físic, també durant el ragdoll.
      if(u.basement?.basement&&u.blastHeight>5.4){u.blastHeight=5.4;imp.vy=Math.min(0,imp.vy)}
      if(u.blastHeight===0)imp.vy=0;
      // En vol es manté l'empenta; a terra es frena ràpid.
      const landed=u.blastHeight===0;
      imp.vx*=Math.exp(-(landed?7:1.7)*dt);
      imp.vz*=Math.exp(-(landed?7:1.7)*dt);
      u.o.position.set(u.x,enemyGroundAt(u,u.x,u.z)+u.blastHeight,u.z);
      const elapsed=(u.blastTotal||2.5)-u.blastT;
      u.o.rotation.z=Math.sin(elapsed*5)*.75*Math.min(1,u.blastHeight+.2);
      if(landed&&u.blastT<.25)u.blastT=0;
      if(u.blastRagdoll)window.HUNTER_RAGDOLL.update(u.blastRagdoll,dt,{
        airborne:!landed,grounded:landed});
    }
    return;
  }
  if(u.blastImpulse){
    if(u.blastRagdoll)window.HUNTER_RAGDOLL.reset(u.blastRagdoll);
    u.blastRagdoll=null;u.blastImpulse=null;u.blastHeight=0;u.o.rotation.z=0
  }
  const oldX=u.x,oldZ=u.z;
  u.alert=Math.max(0,u.alert-dt);u.cd-=dt;if(u.t==='torre')u.heavyCd-=dt;u.playerHitCd=Math.max(0,(u.playerHitCd||0)-dt);
   const q=cv||P,py=cv?cv.o.position.y:P.y,dx=q.x-u.x,dz=q.z-u.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz),
         det=disg&&!cv?20:u.alert>0?300:u.t=='general'?60:120,
        eyeY=u.o.position.y+(u.t=='torre'?9.4:2.2);

  // Dins una casa es pot sentir el jugador encara que una paret talli
  // la línia visual. Això inicia la persecució, mai el tret a cegues.
  // Percepció desacoblada del moviment: ~10 Hz i desfasada entre enemics.
  u.senseT=(u.senseT??0)-dt;
  if(u.senseT<=0){
    u.senseT+=ENEMY_SENSE_DT;
    const bunker=activeBunker,
      localBunker=bunker?.basement?buildingLocalPoint(bunker,q.x,q.z):null,
      withinBunker=!!localBunker&&
        Math.abs(localBunker.x)<bunker.basement.halfX&&
        Math.abs(localBunker.z)<bunker.basement.halfZ,
      acrossFloor=!!(u.basement||withinBunker&&py<bunker.fy-3.9)&&
        Math.abs((u.gy??u.o.position.y)-py)>4.4,
       sameBasement=!!u.basement&&py<bunker.fy-3.9&&eyeY<bunker.fy-3.9,
       // El general pot detectar intrusos dins del mateix nivell sense
       // quedar falsament ocult per la muntanya, però respecta els murs.
       seen=!cheats.invisible&&!over&&!acrossFloor&&d<det&&
         (sameBasement&&u.t==='general'
           ?soldierClearShot(u,u.x,u.z,eyeY,q,py)
           :sight(u.x,u.z,q.x,q.z,eyeY));
    if(u.t==='soldat'){
       const raw=!cheats.invisible&&!!(cv? !over&&d<115&&
         STEALTH.inView(u.hd,dx,py+1.5-eyeY,dz,115)&&
         soldierClearShot(u,u.x,u.z,eyeY,q,py):
         !acrossFloor&&soldierVisualContact(u,q,py,d));
       // La silueta ajupida tarda més a ser reconeguda i només és
       // detectable de prop. Veure-la breument genera sospita, no foc.
       u.recognition=Math.max(0,Math.min(1.5,(u.recognition||0)+
         (raw?ENEMY_SENSE_DT*(d<12?4:((playerCrouched&&!cv)?0.9:2)):-ENEMY_SENSE_DT*3)));
       const confirmed=raw&&u.recognition>=.45;
       const acquired=confirmed&&!u.canSee;
       u.canSee=confirmed;
       u.canShoot=confirmed&&soldierClearShot(u,u.x,u.z,eyeY,q,
         py-(!cv&&playerCrouched?.25:0));
       if(confirmed){
         u.lastSeenX=q.x;u.lastSeenZ=q.z;u.lastSeenY=py;
         u.pursuitT=SOLDIER_MEMORY;u.aiMode='combat';
         u.searchT=SOLDIER_MEMORY+d/Math.max(1,u.sp);
         if(acquired){u.cd=0;soldierWarnNeighbors(u,q,py)}
       }else{
         if(u.aiMode==='combat')u.aiMode='search';
         if(raw&&u.aiMode!=='search'){
           u.aiMode='suspicious';u.lastSeenX=q.x;u.lastSeenZ=q.z;u.lastSeenY=py;
           u.searchT=STEALTH.CONFIG.investigateSeconds+d/Math.max(1,u.sp*.65);
         }else if(!raw&&u.aiMode==='suspicious')u.aiMode='investigate';
         const noise=cheats.invisible?null:STEALTH.heardAt(u.x,eyeY,u.z,u.heardId||0);
         if(noise){
           u.heardId=noise.id;
           if(u.aiMode!=='search'&&u.aiMode!=='combat'){
             u.aiMode='investigate';u.searchT=STEALTH.CONFIG.investigateSeconds+
               Math.hypot(noise.x-u.x,noise.z-u.z)/Math.max(1,u.sp*.65);
           }
           // El soroll no revela la posició ACTUAL del jugador; només
           // deixa un rastre de posició que pot tenir una petita imprecisió.
           const uncertainty=noise.kind==='alert'?0:noise.radius>=100?4:1.5;
           u.lastSeenX=noise.x+Math.sin(u.x+noise.id)*uncertainty;
           u.lastSeenZ=noise.z+Math.cos(u.z+noise.id)*uncertainty;
           u.lastSeenY=noise.y;
         }
       }
      u.defenseTarget=null;
    }else{
      u.canSee=seen;
      u.defenseTarget=seen&&u.sp>0&&d>u.rng*.55?chooseDefense(u,q):null;
    }
  }

   if(u.t==='soldat'&&(u.canSee||u.aiMode&&u.aiMode!=='patrol')){
    u.tacticT=Math.max(0,(u.tacticT||0)-dt);
     const target=u.canSee?q:{x:u.lastSeenX??u.x,z:u.lastSeenZ??u.z},
          targetY=u.canSee?py:(u.lastSeenY??u.o.position.y),
          td=Math.hypot(target.x-u.x,target.z-u.z);
     if(!u.canSee){
       u.searchT=Math.max(0,(u.searchT||0)-dt);
       if(u.searchT<=0){u.aiMode='patrol';u.recognition=0;u.tacticGoal=null}
     }
     if(u.aiMode!=='patrol'){
       const knownBuilding=soldierKnownBuilding(target,targetY),
         entering=!!knownBuilding&&soldierEnterBuilding(u,knownBuilding,target,dt,targetY);
       if(!knownBuilding&&u.entryDoor)releaseSoldierEntry(u);
       if(!entering){
         if(u.canSee)soldierEngage(u,target,targetY,dt,td,true);
         else soldierInvestigate(u,target,dt,u.aiMode==='search'?1:.65);
       }
     }
     if(u.aiMode!=='patrol'&&u.canSee&&u.canShoot&&d<=SOLDIER_FIRE_RANGE&&u.cd<=0){
      u.cd=u.rate;
      const [ax,ay,az]=enemyShotDirection(u,q,py,eyeY);
      if(u.rocketSoldier){
        const fx=-Math.sin(u.hd),fz=-Math.cos(u.hd),
              rightX=Math.cos(u.hd),rightZ=-Math.sin(u.hd);
        shoot(u.x+fx*1.65+rightX*.44,eyeY+.65,
          u.z+fz*1.65+rightZ*.44,ax,ay,az,76,COMBAT_BALANCE.weapons.bazooka,8,'e',mS,1.9,u);
      }else shoot(u.x,eyeY,u.z,ax,ay,az,70,u.dmg,0,'e',mW,SMALL_ARMS_SCALE,u);
    }
  }else if(u.t==='general'&&u.canSee){
    // Fugida lenta mentre dispara. El general continua sempre dins del
    // seu despatx subterrani i no atravessa envans ni mobiliari.
    if(u.basement?.basement?.generalRoom&&d<36&&d>.01){
      const b=u.basement,room=b.basement.generalRoom;
      const nx=dx/d,nz=dz/d;
      const local=buildingLocalPoint(b,u.x-nx*7,u.z-nz*7);
      const destination=buildingWorldPoint(b,
        Math.max(room.xMin,Math.min(room.xMax,local.x)),
        Math.max(room.zMin,Math.min(room.zMax,local.z)));
      if(Math.hypot(destination.x-u.x,destination.z-u.z)>.7)
        mvE(u,u.sp*dt,destination.x,destination.z);
    }
    // Independentment de la direcció de la fugida, mira el jugador.
    u.hd=Math.atan2(u.x-q.x,u.z-q.z);
    if(d<u.rng&&u.cd<=0&&soldierClearShot(u,u.x,u.z,eyeY,q,py)){
      u.cd=u.rate;
      const [ax,ay,az]=enemyShotDirection(u,q,py,eyeY);
      shoot(u.x,eyeY,u.z,ax,ay,az,70,u.dmg,0,'e',mW,SMALL_ARMS_SCALE,u);
    }
  }else if(u.canSee){
    u.hd=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz);
    if(u.sp>0&&d>u.rng*.55){
      const dp=u.defenseTarget;
      if(dp&&Math.hypot(dp.x-u.x,dp.z-u.z)>1.8){
        u.hd=Math.atan2(u.x-dp.x,u.z-dp.z);mvE(u,u.sp*.75*dt,dp.x,dp.z)
      }else if(d>u.rng*.72)mvE(u,u.sp*dt,q.x,q.z)
    }
    if(u.t==='torre'){
      const weapon=towerWeaponForTarget(cv);
      // Mai no fem servir projectils pesats contra una persona a peu.
      // El tipus de tir depèn de si el jugador pilota un vehicle.
      if(weapon==='light'&&d<u.rng&&u.cd<=0){
        u.cd=u.rate;
        const [ax,ay,az]=enemyShotDirection(u,q,py,eyeY),
              fx=-Math.sin(u.hd),fz=-Math.cos(u.hd);
        shoot(u.x+fx*2.4-Math.cos(u.hd)*.72,eyeY,
          u.z+fz*2.4+Math.sin(u.hd)*.72,ax,ay,az,70,u.dmg,0,'e',mW,SMALL_ARMS_SCALE,u);
      }else if(weapon==='heavy'&&d<u.heavyRange&&u.heavyCd<=0){
        u.heavyCd=u.heavyRate;
        const [ax,ay,az]=enemyShotDirection(u,q,py,eyeY-.2),
              fx=-Math.sin(u.hd),fz=-Math.cos(u.hd);
        shoot(u.x+fx*2.4+Math.cos(u.hd)*.72,eyeY-.2,
          u.z+fz*2.4-Math.sin(u.hd)*.72,ax,ay,az,76,COMBAT_BALANCE.weapons.towerHeavy,7,'e',mS,1.8,u);
      }
    }else if(u.t!=='tanc'&&u.t!=='tanqueta'&&d<u.rng&&u.cd<=0){
      if(u.t==='jeep'){
        const rifle=enemyCarRifleShot(u,q,py);
        if(rifle){u.cd=u.rate;const p=rifle.origin,v=rifle.direction;
          shoot(p.x,p.y,p.z,v.x,v.y,v.z,70,u.dmg,0,'e',mW,SMALL_ARMS_SCALE,u)}
      }else{
        u.cd=u.rate;const [ax,ay,az]=enemyShotDirection(u,q,py,eyeY);
        const smallBullet=u.t==='general';
        shoot(u.x,eyeY,u.z,ax,ay,az,u.spl?60:70,u.dmg,u.spl,
          'e',smallBullet?mW:mE,smallBullet?SMALL_ARMS_SCALE:(u.spl?2:1),u);
      }
    }
  }else if(u.sp>0&&u.t!=='general'){
    const waypointDistance=Math.hypot(u.tx-u.x,u.tz-u.z),
          hqPatrolVehicle=u.t==='tanqueta'&&!!u.hqPatrolZone||enemyIsVehicle(u)&&u.compound==='hq'||!!u.interCompoundPatrol;
    // Una tanqueta tarda bastant més de 2,5 s a travessar un tram
    // de 68 m. No li avancem el waypoint abans d'arribar-hi:
    // això la feia tallar pel búnquer i acabar encallada a les cantonades.
    // Marge de 30 s sobre el temps previst del tram per recuperar bloquejos.
    if((hqPatrolVehicle?(u.pi<0||waypointDistance<5||u.wt< -30):
        (u.wt<=0||waypointDistance<2))){
      if(u.patrol&&u.patrol.length){
        u.pi=((u.pi==null?-1:u.pi)+1)%u.patrol.length;u.tx=u.patrol[u.pi].x;u.tz=u.patrol[u.pi].z;u.wt=hqPatrolVehicle?Math.max(2.5,Math.hypot(u.tx-u.x,u.tz-u.z)/Math.max(1,u.sp*.35)):u.guard?2.5:8
      }else{
        const roam=u.guard?8:25;u.tx=u.home.x+rr(-roam,roam);u.tz=u.home.z+rr(-roam,roam);u.wt=u.guard?3:6
      }
    }
    u.wt-=dt;u.hd=Math.atan2(u.x-u.tx,u.z-u.tz);mvE(u,u.sp*(u.guard?.35:.5)*dt)
  }

  u.o.position.set(u.x,(u.gy!=null?u.gy:enemyGroundAt(u,u.x,u.z))+(u.t=='jeep'||u.t=='tanc'?.05:0),u.z);
  if(u.t==='soldat'||u.t==='general')enemyStepSound(u,Math.hypot(u.x-oldX,u.z-oldZ));
  if(enemyIsVehicle(u)){
    // Velocitat real del desplaçament, no la velocitat nominal de patrulla.
    // La col·lisió amb un jugador a peu la consultarà al fotograma següent.
    u.impactFromX=oldX;u.impactFromZ=oldZ;
    u.impactSpeed=dt>.0001?Math.hypot(u.x-oldX,u.z-oldZ)/dt:0;
    u.hd=u.navHd??u.hd;
  }
  // Enemics que comparteixen model de cotxe/tanqueta: el tren davanter
  // segueix la direcció real del moviment, sense canviar la seva IA.
  const lastVisualHeading=u.o.rotation.y;
  if(u.t!='torre')u.o.rotation.y=u.hd;
  else if(u.o.userData.towerTurret)u.o.userData.towerTurret.rotation.y=u.hd;
  // Blindats enemics: la torreta segueix el jugador independentment del
  // rumb de patrulla. Cada ràfega té una dispersió estable mentre apunten,
  // i el tret neix al canó quan aquest ha acabat d'orientar-se.
  if((u.t==='tanc'||u.t==='tanqueta')&&u.o.userData.turretPivot){
    let desired=new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(u.hd),0,-Math.cos(u.hd));
    if(u.canSee){
      if(!u.armoredAimSpread){
        const spread=enemyAimSpread(),
              boost=u.spl?1+Math.min(1,u.spl/8)*(spread-1)*.5:1,
              horizontal=1.5*spread*boost,
              vertical=.85*(spread-1);
        u.armoredAimSpread={x:rn(-horizontal,horizontal),
          y:vertical?rn(-vertical,vertical):0,z:rn(-horizontal,horizontal)};
      }
      const offset=u.armoredAimSpread,
            gun=window.HUNTER_VEHICLES.turretShot(THREE,u.o);
       if(gun)desired.set(q.x+offset.x-gun.origin.x,
         py+(!cv&&playerCrouched?1.25:1.5)+offset.y-gun.origin.y,q.z+offset.z-gun.origin.z);
    }else u.armoredAimSpread=null;
    const aligned=window.HUNTER_VEHICLES.aimTurret(THREE,u.o,desired,dt);
    if(u.canSee&&d<u.rng&&u.cd<=0&&aligned){
      const gun=window.HUNTER_VEHICLES.turretShot(THREE,u.o);
      if(gun){
        u.cd=u.rate;u.armoredAimSpread=null;
        const p=gun.origin,v=gun.direction,small=u.t==='tanqueta';
        shoot(p.x,p.y,p.z,v.x,v.y,v.z,u.spl?60:70,u.dmg,u.spl,
          'e',small?mW:mE,small?SMALL_ARMS_SCALE:(u.spl?2:1),u);
      }
    }
  }
  if((u.t==='jeep'||u.t==='tanqueta')&&u.o.userData.steeringPivots){
    const dxMoved=u.x-oldX,dzMoved=u.z-oldZ,
          distance=Math.hypot(dxMoved,dzMoved),
          delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(u.hd-lastVisualHeading),Math.cos(u.hd-lastVisualHeading)),
          visualTurn=distance>.003&&dt>0?Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,delta/(1.6*dt))):0;
    window.HUNTER_VEHICLES.animateSteering(u.o,u.t==='jeep'?'cotxe':u.t,visualTurn,dt);
    if(distance>.003){
      const signedDistance=dxMoved*(-Math.sin(u.hd))+dzMoved*(-Math.cos(u.hd));
      for(const wheel of u.o.userData.wheels||[])wheel.rotation.x-=signedDistance/(wheel.userData.radius||.65);
    }
  }
  if(u.o.userData.legs){
    const a=u.o.userData;u.phase=(u.phase||0)+dt*u.sp;
    const moving=Math.hypot(u.x-oldX,u.z-oldZ)>.001,swing=moving?Math.sin(u.phase)*.45:0;
    if(a.knees&&a.enemyLOD==='full')window.HUNTER_CHARACTERS.animateSoldier(u.o,{phase:u.phase,moving,aim:!!u.canSee,dt});
    else if(a.knees&&a.enemyLOD==='mid'){
      u.visualAnimT=(u.visualAnimT||0)+dt;
      if(u.visualAnimT>=.16){a.enemyMidMesh.rotation.z=moving?Math.sin(u.phase)*.035:0;u.visualAnimT=0}
    }
    else{
    a.legs[0].rotation.x=swing;a.legs[1].rotation.x=-swing;
    const aim=!!u.canSee;
    a.arms.forEach((arm,i)=>arm.rotation.x+=((aim?(u.rocketSoldier?(i?1.2:1.04):1.45):(i?swing:-swing)*.5)-arm.rotation.x)*(1-Math.exp(-12*dt)))
    }
  }
})}
function updDead(dt){
  for(let i=DEAD.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const u=DEAD[i],pose=u.deadPose||(u.deadPose={yaw:0,roll:u.deadSide*1.4,
      pitch:0,armL:-.5,armR:.5,legL:-.2,legR:.2,vx:0,vz:0,vy:0,height:0});
    u.deadT+=dt;
    const k=Math.min(1,u.deadT/.65),e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
    pose.vy-=18*dt;
    pose.height=Math.max(0,pose.height+pose.vy*dt);
    if(pose.height===0){pose.vy=0;pose.vx*=Math.exp(-9*dt);pose.vz*=Math.exp(-9*dt)}
    else{pose.vx*=Math.exp(-1.1*dt);pose.vz*=Math.exp(-1.1*dt)}
    u.x+=pose.vx*dt;u.z+=pose.vz*dt;
    const base=u.basement?u.basement.basement.floorY:Math.max(0,hAt(u.x,u.z));
    u.o.position.set(u.x,base+pose.height+.05+(1-e)*.12,u.z);
    u.o.rotation.set(pose.pitch*e,u.hd+pose.yaw*e,pose.roll*e,'YXZ');
    if(u.ragdoll){
      // El ragdoll queda en repòs després de 3,2 s. Els cadàvers
      // continuen visibles fins als 18 s, però ja no consumeixen
      // integracions d'articulacions durant els últims fotogrames.
      if(u.deadT<3.2||pose.height>.09)
        window.HUNTER_RAGDOLL.update(u.ragdoll,dt,{
          airborne:pose.height>.09,grounded:pose.height<=.09});
    }else{
      // Animació específica del general, controlada per la victòria.
      if(u.o.userData.arms)u.o.userData.arms.forEach((arm,j)=>{
        arm.rotation.x=(j?pose.armR:pose.armL)*e;
        arm.rotation.z=(j?-.3:.3)*e;
      });
      if(u.o.userData.legs)u.o.userData.legs.forEach((leg,j)=>
        leg.rotation.x=(j?pose.legR:pose.legL)*e);
    }
    if(u.deadT>18){
      if(u.ragdoll){window.HUNTER_RAGDOLL.reset(u.ragdoll);u.ragdoll=null}
      world.remove(u.o);DEAD.splice(i,1)
    }
  }
}

function attachEnemyCarCrew(car){
  const makeSoldier=()=>window.HUNTER_CHARACTERS.createSoldier(THREE,{box:bx,material:M}),
        driver=makeSoldier(),gunner=makeSoldier();
  driver.position.set(-.73,.94,-.43);gunner.position.set(.72,.94,-.43);
  driver.scale.setScalar(.43);gunner.scale.setScalar(.43);
  driver.userData.ar.rotation.x=1.18;driver.userData.al.rotation.x=1.12;
  gunner.userData.ar.rotation.x=1.25;gunner.userData.aer.rotation.x=.35;
  gunner.rotation.y=.26;
  // Un conductor sense fusell; l'artiller treu el seu per la finestra.
  driver.userData.gun.visible=false;
  const rifle=gunner.userData.gun;
  rifle.parent.remove(rifle);
  const mount=new THREE.Group(),pitch=new THREE.Group();
  mount.position.set(1.46,2.07,-.30);mount.add(pitch);car.add(mount);
  rifle.position.set(0,-.035,-.14);rifle.rotation.set(0,0,0);rifle.scale.setScalar(.94);
  pitch.add(rifle);
  // Tram final visible del canó; el marcador coincideix amb l'extrem.
  bx(rifle,.075,.075,.42,0x252d2c,0,0,-.97,'metal');
  const muzzle=new THREE.Object3D();muzzle.position.set(0,0,-1.18);rifle.add(muzzle);
  car.add(driver,gunner);
  car.userData.enemyCarCrew={driver,gunner,mount,pitch,muzzle};
}
function mkEn(t,x,z,gy,options={}){const c=EC[t];let g;
if(seedSearchMode){
  g=new THREE.Group();
  // Mateixos registres de col·lisió de les potes, sense construir la torre.
  if(t==='torre')g.userData.towerLegMeshes=[-1.45,1.45].flatMap(lx=>
    [-1.45,1.45].map(lz=>({position:{x:lx,y:3.9,z:lz},
      geometry:{parameters:{width:.38,height:7.8,depth:.38}}})));
}
else if(t=='soldat'||t=='general'){g=window.HUNTER_CHARACTERS.createSoldier(THREE,{box:bx,material:M,general:t==='general',elite:!!options.elite})}
else if(t==='patrulla_marina'){g=mkV('llanxa');createMarinePatrolVisual(g)}
else if(t=='jeep'){g=mkV('cotxe');attachEnemyCarCrew(g);bx(g,.2,2,.2,0xff2020,0,3.4,0)}
else if(t=='tanqueta'){g=mkV('tanqueta');bx(g,.18,1.7,.18,0xff2020,0,3.2,.4)}
else if(t=='tanc'){g=mkV('tanc');bx(g,.2,2,.2,0xff2020,0,4,0)}
else if(t=='torre'){g=new THREE.Group();const leg=0x4b5157,deck=0x626b70,cabin=0x7c2f2f,roof=0x343a3e;
g.userData.towerLegMeshes=[];
for(const lx of[-1.45,1.45])for(const lz of[-1.45,1.45])
  g.userData.towerLegMeshes.push(bx(g,.38,7.8,.38,leg,lx,3.9,lz,'metal'));
bx(g,4.4,.45,4.4,deck,0,7.9,0,'metal');
for(const x of[-2.05,2.05])bx(g,.16,1.25,4.15,leg,x,8.65,0,'metal');
for(const z of[-2.05,2.05])bx(g,4.15,1.25,.16,leg,0,8.65,z,'metal');
bx(g,2.75,1.8,2.75,cabin,0,9.15,0,'paint');
bx(g,1.9,.72,.08,0x6b9aa5,0,9.35,-1.39,'glass');
bx(g,3.35,.28,3.35,roof,0,10.25,0,'metal');
// Dues armes orientables: lleugera a l'esquerra i pesada a la dreta.
const turret=new THREE.Group();turret.position.y=9.25;g.add(turret);
bx(turret,.32,.32,2.1,roof,-.72,0,-2.25,'metal');
bx(turret,.58,.58,2.35,0x37433c,.72,-.2,-2.25,'metal');
bx(turret,.68,.65,.22,0x666b62,.72,-.2,-3.43,'metal');
g.userData.towerTurret=turret;
bx(g,.42,.8,.42,0xe4d36f,0,10.78,0,'paint')}
else{g=new THREE.Group();bx(g,1,1,.6,0x222222,0,.5,0);bx(g,1.3,1.6,.7,0xd4af37,0,1.8,0);bx(g,.8,.8,.8,0xf0c9a0,0,3,0);bx(g,.9,.5,.9,0xaa0000,0,3.6,0);g.scale.setScalar(1.2)}
if(!seedSearchMode&&t!=='soldat'&&t!=='general')window.HUNTER_ENEMY_LOD.optimize(THREE,g,t);
if(!seedSearchMode)world.add(g);const sensePhase=(E.length%10)*.01,u={t,x,z,gy,hd:rr(0,6.28),o:g,home:{x,z},cd:rr(0,1),alert:0,wt:0,tx:x,tz:z,senseT:sensePhase,canSee:false,defenseTarget:null,...c};
if(options.elite){u.elite=true;u.hp=COMBAT_BALANCE.people.elite;u.dmg=COMBAT_BALANCE.weapons.eliteRifle;u.rng=85;u.rate=TANKETTE_FIRE_INTERVAL;u.sp=8;u.cd=.4+(E.length%4)*.14}
if(t==='torre'){u.heavyCd=1.6+(E.length%5)*.4;u.heavyRate=4.2;u.heavyRange=95}
E.push(u);
if(t==='torre'){
  const base=gy??enemyGroundAt(u,x,z);
  // Cada pota té el seu propi AABB: el pas entre les quatre continua obert.
  // Compartir Wl fa que jugador, vehicles, IA i projectils el respectin.
  u.towerLegColliders=g.userData.towerLegMeshes.map(m=>{
    const hw=m.geometry.parameters.width/2,hd=m.geometry.parameters.depth/2,
          hh=m.geometry.parameters.height/2,cx=x+m.position.x,cz=z+m.position.z;
    return {towerLegOwner:u,m,x0:cx-hw,x1:cx+hw,z0:cz-hd,z1:cz+hd,
      y0:base+m.position.y-hh,y1:base+m.position.y+hh,
      hp:Infinity,door:false,open:false,rammable:false,cx,cz};
  });
  Wl.push(...u.towerLegColliders);
}
return u}


;
// END src/enemy-ai.js
// BEGIN src/audio.js
// L'àudio només representa el món: mai no emet ni consumeix sorolls de STEALTH.
// Els buffers es comparteixen; cada reproducció té una font i nodes propis.
const AUDIO_SOUNDS=Object.freeze({
 shot:{duration:.12,filter:'highpass',frequency:1200,gain:.5,range:140},
 cannon:{duration:.35,frequency:600,gain:.5,range:140},
 boom:{duration:.7,frequency:300,gain:.5,range:200,priority:2},
 hurt:{duration:.15,frequency:600,gain:.5},
 step:{duration:.085,frequency:440,gain:.15,fade:3},
 enemyStep:{duration:.085,frequency:440,gain:.15,fade:3,range:30,throttle:.18,priority:0},
 swim:{duration:.24,frequency:1100,gain:.32},
 pick:{duration:.2,gain:.15},
 alert:{duration:.38,frequency:1250,gain:.32,range:70,throttle:.8,priority:2},
 replayShot:{duration:.24,frequency:750,gain:.31,fade:2.4,rate:.55},
 replayCannon:{duration:.42,frequency:340,gain:.44,fade:2.4,rate:.55}
});
const audioRuntime={context:null,master:null,buffers:new WeakMap(),voices:new Set(),
 objectTimes:new WeakMap(),sourceTimes:new Map(),steps:new WeakMap(),paused:false,
 muted:false,resumeSerial:0,listener:{x:0,y:1.65,z:0},maxVoices:24,maxWorldVoices:18};
function audioIsMuted(){return typeof muted!=='undefined'&&!!muted}
function audioVisible(){return !(typeof document!=='undefined'&&document.hidden)}
function audioCanPlay(){
 return !!AC&&!audioRuntime.paused&&!audioIsMuted()&&audioVisible()&&
   !(typeof simulationFocused!=='undefined'&&!simulationFocused)&&
   AC.state!=='suspended'&&AC.state!=='interrupted'&&AC.state!=='closed';
}
function audioDisconnect(node){try{node?.disconnect?.()}catch(e){}}
function audioReleaseVoice(voice,stop=false){
 if(!audioRuntime.voices.delete(voice))return;
 voice.source.onended=null;
 if(stop)try{voice.source.stop()}catch(e){}
 for(const node of voice.nodes)audioDisconnect(node);
}
function audioClearVoices(){
 for(const voice of [...audioRuntime.voices])audioReleaseVoice(voice,true);
 audioRuntime.objectTimes=new WeakMap();audioRuntime.sourceTimes.clear();audioRuntime.steps=new WeakMap();
}
function audioPrune(){
 const now=AC?.currentTime||0;
 for(const voice of audioRuntime.voices)if(now>voice.end+.05)audioReleaseVoice(voice,true);
 for(const [key,time] of audioRuntime.sourceTimes)if(now-time>8)audioRuntime.sourceTimes.delete(key);
}
function audioReserveVoice(priority,spatial){
 audioPrune();
 if(spatial){
  const world=[...audioRuntime.voices].filter(voice=>voice.position);
  if(world.length>=audioRuntime.maxWorldVoices){
   const victim=world.find(voice=>voice.priority<=priority);if(!victim)return false;
   audioReleaseVoice(victim,true);
  }
 }
 if(audioRuntime.voices.size>=audioRuntime.maxVoices){
  const victim=[...audioRuntime.voices].find(voice=>voice.priority<=priority);
  if(!victim)return false;
  audioReleaseVoice(victim,true);
 }
 return true;
}
function audioOwnVoice(source,nodes,{duration,priority=2,position=null,gain=null,baseGain=0,range=0}={}){
 const voice={source,nodes,priority,position,gain,baseGain,range,end:AC.currentTime+duration};
 audioRuntime.voices.add(voice);source.onended=()=>audioReleaseVoice(voice);
 return voice;
}
function audioStopLoops(){
 if(eng?.g?.gain){eng.g.gain.cancelScheduledValues?.(AC?.currentTime||0);eng.g.gain.value=0}
 if(seaAudio?.gain?.gain){seaAudio.gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues?.(AC?.currentTime||0);seaAudio.gain.gain.value=0}
}
function audioDisposeGraph(){
 audioClearVoices();
 const engine=typeof eng!=='undefined'?eng:null,sea=typeof seaAudio!=='undefined'?seaAudio:null;
 for(const source of [engine?.o,sea?.noise])if(source)try{source.stop()}catch(e){}
 for(const node of [engine?.o,engine?.g,sea?.noise,sea?.filter,sea?.gain,audioRuntime.master])audioDisconnect(node);
 eng=null;seaAudio=null;audioRuntime.master=null;
}
function audioUseContext(){
 if(audioRuntime.context===AC)return;
 audioDisposeGraph();audioRuntime.context=AC;audioRuntime.resumeSerial++;
}
function audioOutput(){
 audioUseContext();
 if(!audioRuntime.master){
  const gain=AC.createGain();gain.gain.value=audioIsMuted()?0:1;
  gain.connect(AC.destination);audioRuntime.master=gain;
 }
 return audioRuntime.master;
}
function audioNoise(seed){
 let state=seed>>>0;
 return ()=>{state=(Math.imul(state,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return state/2147483648-1};
}
function audioBuffer(type){
 let cache=audioRuntime.buffers.get(AC);if(!cache)audioRuntime.buffers.set(AC,cache=new Map());
 if(cache.has(type))return cache.get(type);
 const spec=AUDIO_SOUNDS[type],duration=type==='sea'?8:spec.duration,
       length=Math.max(1,Math.floor(AC.sampleRate*duration)),buffer=AC.createBuffer(1,length,AC.sampleRate),
       samples=buffer.getChannelData(0),noise=audioNoise([...type].reduce((n,c)=>Math.imul(n,31)+c.charCodeAt(0),5171));
 let low=0,phase=0;
 for(let i=0;i<length;i++){
  const p=i/length,t=i/AC.sampleRate,n=noise();
  if(type==='sea'){
   low=.985*low+.015*n;const swell=.35+.65*Math.pow(.5+.5*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*4),2);
   samples[i]=low*9*swell;
  }else if(type==='swim'){
   low=low*.83+n*.17;samples[i]=(low*.8+n*.18)*Math.pow(1-p,2.4);
  }else if(type==='pick'){
   phase+=Math.PI*2*(t<.08?660:990)/AC.sampleRate;
   samples[i]=Math.sin(phase)*Math.pow(.001/.15,p);
  }else if(type==='alert'){
   // Dos accents breus i aspres; diferent del cop de bota i de la recollida.
   phase+=Math.PI*2*(t<.18?310:420)/AC.sampleRate;
   const syllable=t<.18?t/.18:(t-.18)/.2,envelope=Math.sin(Math.PI*syllable)**2;
   samples[i]=(Math.sin(phase)*.65+n*.35)*envelope;
  }else samples[i]=n*Math.pow(1-p,spec.fade||2);
 }
 cache.set(type,buffer);return buffer;
}
function audioInitLoops(){
 const output=audioOutput();
 if(!eng){
  const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();
  try{o.type='sawtooth';o.frequency.value=40;g.gain.value=0;o.connect(g);g.connect(output);o.start();eng={o,g}}
  catch(e){try{o.stop()}catch(e){}audioDisconnect(o);audioDisconnect(g)}
 }
 if(!seaAudio){
  const noise=AC.createBufferSource(),filter=AC.createBiquadFilter(),gain=AC.createGain();
  try{
   noise.buffer=audioBuffer('sea');noise.loop=true;filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=850;gain.gain.value=0;
   noise.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(output);noise.start();seaAudio={noise,filter,gain};
  }catch(e){try{noise.stop()}catch(e){}audioDisconnect(noise);audioDisconnect(filter);audioDisconnect(gain)}
 }
}
function audioSuspend(){
 const context=AC;
 try{return Promise.resolve(context?.suspend?.()).then(()=>false,()=>false)}catch(e){return Promise.resolve(false)}
}
function audioResume(){
 audioRuntime.paused=false;
 if(!AC||audioIsMuted()||!audioVisible()||typeof simulationFocused!=='undefined'&&!simulationFocused)return Promise.resolve(false);
 const context=AC,serial=++audioRuntime.resumeSerial;
 // resume() s'invoca ara, dins del gest; la promesa sempre queda capturada.
 let resumed;try{resumed=context.resume?.()}catch(e){return Promise.resolve(false)}
 return Promise.resolve(resumed).then(()=>{
  if(AC!==context)return false;
  if(audioRuntime.paused||audioIsMuted()||!audioVisible()||
    typeof simulationFocused!=='undefined'&&!simulationFocused){audioSuspend();return false}
  if(serial!==audioRuntime.resumeSerial)return false;
  if(audioRuntime.master)audioRuntime.master.gain.value=1;
  return context.state!=='suspended'&&context.state!=='closed';
 },()=>false);
}
function initAudio(options={}){
 try{
  const host=typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis;
  if(!AC||AC.state==='closed'){
   const primed=host.HUNTER_PRIMED_AUDIO_CONTEXT,
         Constructor=host.AudioContext||host.webkitAudioContext;
   if(primed&&primed.state!=='closed')AC=primed;
   else if(Constructor)AC=new Constructor();
   else return Promise.resolve(false);
  }
  host.HUNTER_PRIMED_AUDIO_CONTEXT=AC;
  audioUseContext();
  const resumed=audioResume();
  if(!options.unlockOnly)audioInitLoops();
  return resumed;
 }catch(e){return Promise.resolve(false)}
}
function audioPause(){
 audioRuntime.paused=true;audioRuntime.resumeSerial++;audioClearVoices();audioStopLoops();
 if(audioRuntime.master)audioRuntime.master.gain.value=0;
 return audioSuspend();
}
function audioReset(){
 audioRuntime.resumeSerial++;audioClearVoices();audioStopLoops();
}
function setAudioMuted(value){
 muted=!!value;audioRuntime.muted=muted;
 if(muted){
  audioRuntime.resumeSerial++;audioClearVoices();audioStopLoops();
  if(audioRuntime.master)audioRuntime.master.gain.value=0;
  audioSuspend();
 }else if(!audioRuntime.paused&&!(typeof paused!=='undefined'&&paused))return audioResume();
 return Promise.resolve(false);
}
function audioSetPosition(node,point){
 if(node.positionX){node.positionX.value=point.x;node.positionY.value=point.y;node.positionZ.value=point.z}
 else node.setPosition?.(point.x,point.y,point.z);
}
function audioDistanceGain(position,range){
 const ear=audioRuntime.listener;
 return Math.max(0,1-Math.hypot(position.x-ear.x,position.y-ear.y,position.z-ear.z)/range);
}
function updateAudioListener(){
 if(!AC)return;
 let player=typeof P!=='undefined'?P:null;
 if(typeof deathCinematic!=='undefined'&&deathCinematic?.active&&typeof pl!=='undefined')player=pl.position;
 if(player)audioRuntime.listener={x:player.x,y:(player.y||0)+1.65,z:player.z};
 const listener=AC.listener;
 if(listener){
  audioSetPosition(listener,audioRuntime.listener);
  let camera=typeof cam!=='undefined'?cam:null;
  if(typeof deathVoidReady==='function'&&deathVoidReady())camera=deathCinematic.voidCamera;
  camera?.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
  const e=camera?.matrixWorld?.elements;
  if(e){
   const f=Math.hypot(e[8],e[9],e[10])||1,u=Math.hypot(e[4],e[5],e[6])||1,
         forward=[-e[8]/f,-e[9]/f,-e[10]/f],up=[e[4]/u,e[5]/u,e[6]/u];
   if(listener.forwardX){
    for(const [name,values] of [['forward',forward],['up',up]])
     for(let i=0;i<3;i++)listener[name+'XYZ'[i]].value=values[i];
   }else listener.setOrientation?.(...forward,...up);
  }
 }
 for(const voice of audioRuntime.voices)if(voice.position&&voice.gain)
  voice.gain.gain.value=voice.baseGain*audioDistanceGain(voice.position,voice.range);
}
function updateAudioFrame(){
 if(!AC)return;
 if(audioRuntime.muted!==audioIsMuted())setAudioMuted(audioIsMuted());
 if((typeof paused!=='undefined'&&paused)||!audioVisible()||
   typeof simulationFocused!=='undefined'&&!simulationFocused){
  if(!audioRuntime.paused)audioPause();
  return;
 }
 if(typeof over!=='undefined'&&over)audioStopLoops();
 updateAudioListener();audioPrune();
}
function audioThrottle(type,source,position,interval){
 const now=AC.currentTime;
 if(source&&(typeof source==='object'||typeof source==='function')){
  let times=audioRuntime.objectTimes.get(source);
  if(!times)audioRuntime.objectTimes.set(source,times=new Map());
  const previous=times.get(type);if(previous!==undefined&&now-previous<interval)return false;
  times.set(type,now);return true;
 }
 const key=type+':'+(source??(position?Math.round(position.x)+','+Math.round(position.y)+','+Math.round(position.z):'personal')),
       previous=audioRuntime.sourceTimes.get(key);
 if(previous!==undefined&&now-previous<interval)return false;
 // Cap estricte també quan el context no avança o hi ha molts impactes diferents.
 if(audioRuntime.sourceTimes.size>=256)audioRuntime.sourceTimes.delete(audioRuntime.sourceTimes.keys().next().value);
 audioRuntime.sourceTimes.set(key,now);return true;
}
function snd(type,volume=1,position=null,source=null){
 if(!audioCanPlay()||!Number.isFinite(volume)||volume<=.02)return false;
 const t=Object.hasOwn(AUDIO_SOUNDS,type)?type:'hurt',spec=AUDIO_SOUNDS[t],
       spatial=position&&Number.isFinite(position.x)&&Number.isFinite(position.y)&&Number.isFinite(position.z),
       point=spatial?{x:position.x,y:position.y,z:position.z}:null,range=spec.range||140,
       priority=spatial?(spec.priority??1):3;
 try{
  audioOutput();updateAudioListener();
  if(point&&audioDistanceGain(point,range)<=.001)return false;
  if(!audioThrottle(t,source,point,spec.throttle||.06)||!audioReserveVoice(priority,spatial))return false;
  const buffer=audioBuffer(t),voiceNodes=[],s=AC.createBufferSource();voiceNodes.push(s);
  let voice;
  try{
   s.buffer=buffer;if(spec.rate)s.playbackRate.value=spec.rate;
   const gain=AC.createGain();voiceNodes.push(gain);
   const baseGain=spec.gain*Math.min(1,volume);
   gain.gain.value=baseGain*(point?audioDistanceGain(point,range):1);
   let tail=s;
   if(spec.frequency){
    const filter=AC.createBiquadFilter();voiceNodes.push(filter);filter.type=spec.filter||'lowpass';
    filter.frequency.value=spec.frequency;tail.connect(filter);tail=filter;
   }
   tail.connect(gain);tail=gain;
   if(point&&AC.createPanner){
    let panner;
    try{
     panner=AC.createPanner();panner.panningModel='HRTF';panner.distanceModel='linear';
     // Una sola atenuació, al gain anterior; el Panner només aporta direcció.
     panner.refDistance=1;panner.maxDistance=range;panner.rolloffFactor=0;
     audioSetPosition(panner,point);gain.connect(panner);tail=panner;voiceNodes.push(panner);
    }catch(e){audioDisconnect(panner)}
   }
   tail.connect(audioRuntime.master);
   voice=audioOwnVoice(s,voiceNodes,{duration:spec.duration/(spec.rate||1),priority,
     position:point,gain,baseGain,range});
   s.start(AC.currentTime);return true;
  }catch(e){if(voice)audioReleaseVoice(voice,true);else for(const node of voiceNodes)audioDisconnect(node);return false}
 }catch(e){return false}
}
function enemyStepSound(unit,distance){
 if(!audioCanPlay()||!(distance>0)||distance>4)return;
 let travelled=(audioRuntime.steps.get(unit)||0)+distance;
 if(travelled>=1.6){
  travelled%=1.6;snd('enemyStep',.9,{x:unit.x,y:unit.o.position.y+.12,z:unit.z},unit);
 }
 audioRuntime.steps.set(unit,travelled);
}
// Campanes i cant cinematogràfic conserven síntesi i cadència originals,
// però ara participen del límit de veus i de la neteja de pausa/reinici.
function deathBell(volume=1){
 if(!audioCanPlay())return;
 try{
  const now=AC.currentTime,partials=[1,2.01,2.49,3.98,5.03],strengths=[.38,.17,.13,.08,.045],output=audioOutput();
  for(let i=0;i<partials.length;i++){
   if(!audioReserveVoice(4,false))break;
   const osc=AC.createOscillator(),gain=AC.createGain(),
         start=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,volume))*strengths[i],length=4.4-i*.43;
   osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(174.61*partials[i],now);
   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(start,now+.012);
   gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+length);
   osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(output);
   audioOwnVoice(osc,[osc,gain],{duration:length+.03,priority:4});
   osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+length+.03);
  }
 }catch(e){}
}
function audioGullCry(){
 if(!audioCanPlay())return;
 try{
  const now=AC.currentTime,output=audioOutput();if(!audioReserveVoice(3,false))return;
  const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();
  o.type='sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(1280,now);
  o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(830,now+.14);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1100,now+.28);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(.001,now);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.055,now+.06);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+.36);
  o.connect(g);g.connect(output);audioOwnVoice(o,[o,g],{duration:.37,priority:3});o.start(now);o.stop(now+.37);
 }catch(e){}
}

;
// END src/audio.js
// BEGIN src/victory-pose.js
// Postura compartida entre el final jugable i la previsualització.
// Roda el general al voltant del maluc (no dels peus) i eleva els braços
// cap a fora abans de la caiguda per evitar que quedin dins la gavardina.
window.HUNTER_VICTORY_POSE=Object.freeze((()=>{
  const clamp=t=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
  const ease=t=>{const x=clamp(t);return x*x*(3-2*x)};
  const joints=items=>(items||[]).filter(Boolean).map(node=>({
    node,rotation:node.rotation.clone()
  }));
  function capture(THREE,model,direction,pelvisHeight=1.35){
    const rig=model.userData||{};
    const fallDir=new THREE.Vector3(direction?.x||0,0,direction?.z||-1);
    if(fallDir.lengthSq()<.00001)fallDir.set(0,0,-1);
    fallDir.normalize();
    const axis=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0).cross(fallDir).normalize();
    return {
      THREE,model,axis,pelvisHeight,
      position:model.position.clone(),quaternion:model.quaternion.clone(),
      hips:joints(rig.legs||[rig.ll,rig.lr]),
      knees:joints(rig.knees||[rig.lkl,rig.lkr]),
      arms:joints(rig.arms||[rig.al,rig.ar]),
      elbows:joints(rig.elbows||[rig.ael,rig.aer]),
      head:joints([rig.head])
    };
  }
  function apply(pose,progress){
    const {THREE,model}=pose,p=clamp(progress);
    const lift=ease((p-.01)/.35),fall=ease((p-.16)/.81);
    const recoil=Math.sin(Math.PI*clamp(p/.29))*.13;
    const angle=recoil+1.48*fall;
    // Angle al món: el cos cau allunyant-se de la trajectòria entrant.
    model.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(pose.axis,angle).multiply(pose.quaternion);
    // Rotació al voltant del maluc, després el cos s'assenta al terra.
    const pelvis=new THREE.Vector3(0,pose.pelvisHeight,0);
    const before=pelvis.clone().applyQuaternion(pose.quaternion);
    const after=pelvis.clone().applyQuaternion(model.quaternion);
    model.position.copy(pose.position).add(before).sub(after);
    model.position.y-=.83*fall;

    pose.arms.forEach(({node,rotation},i)=>{
      const side=i===0?-1:1;
      // > 90 graus de separació: mans per sobre de la línia d'espatlles,
      // sense travessar la gavardina ni amagar-les en el tronc.
      node.rotation.set(rotation.x+(i===0?-.27:.22)*lift,
        rotation.y+side*.32*lift,
        rotation.z+side*2.03*lift);
    });
    pose.elbows.forEach(({node,rotation},i)=>{
      node.rotation.copy(rotation);
      node.rotation.x+=(i===0?.27:.34)*lift;
      node.rotation.z+=(i===0?-.10:.10)*lift;
    });
    pose.hips.forEach(({node,rotation},i)=>{
      node.rotation.copy(rotation);node.rotation.x+=(i===0?-.23:.29)*fall;
    });
    pose.knees.forEach(({node,rotation},i)=>{
      node.rotation.copy(rotation);node.rotation.x-=(i===0?.39:.63)*fall;
    });
    pose.head.forEach(({node,rotation})=>{
      node.rotation.copy(rotation);
      node.rotation.x-=.30*ease((p-.08)/.46);
    });
  }
  return {capture,apply};
})());

;
// END src/victory-pose.js
// BEGIN src/victory-cinematic.js
// Cinemàtica de victòria: la simulació queda aturada, però l'escena,
 // la càmera, les gavines i el mar continuen renderitzant-se.
const VICTORY_REPLAY_SECONDS=2.35,VICTORY_OVERHEAD_SECONDS=3.25,
      VICTORY_SUNSET_SECONDS=8.7;
let victoryCinematic=null;

const victoryClamp=t=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
const victoryEase=t=>{const p=victoryClamp(t);return p*p*(3-2*p)};

function victoryShotSnapshot(general,shot){
  const attack=shot?.weapon==='knife'?'knife':shot?.weapon==='grenade'?'grenade':
    shot?.weapon==='bazooka'||shot?.own==='pb'?'rocket':
    !shot?'impact':shot.spl>0&&!Number.isFinite(shot.vx)?'explosion':'bullet';
  const hit=new THREE.Vector3(general.x,general.o.position.y+1.6,general.z),
        from=shot&&Number.isFinite(shot.sx)&&Number.isFinite(shot.sz)
          ?new THREE.Vector3(shot.sx,shot.sy,shot.sz)
          :new THREE.Vector3(cv?.x??P.x,(cv?.o?.position.y??P.y)+1.6,cv?.z??P.z),
        impact=shot&&Number.isFinite(shot.x)&&Number.isFinite(shot.y)
          ?new THREE.Vector3(shot.x,shot.y,shot.z):hit.clone();
  let direction=impact.clone().sub(from);
  if(direction.lengthSq()<.01)direction=hit.clone().sub(from);
  if(direction.lengthSq()<.01)direction.set(0,0,-1);
  direction.normalize();
  const distance=Math.min(34,Math.max(7,from.distanceTo(hit)));
  return {hit,from,impact,direction,attack,
    approach:attack==='grenade'?from.clone():hit.clone().addScaledVector(direction,-distance),
    heavy:!!(shot?.spl>0),source:shot?.own||'p'};
}

function victoryReplayProjectile(shot,source){
  if(shot.attack==='knife'||shot.attack==='impact'||shot.attack==='explosion')return null;
  if(shot.attack==='grenade'&&source?.o)return source.o.clone(true);
  if(shot.attack==='rocket'){
    // Coet amb cos i aletes recognoscibles, diferent de l'ojiva del canó.
    const rocket=new THREE.Group(),metal=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x6f7960,metalness:.48,roughness:.48}),
          body=new THREE.Mesh(gHeavy,metal);
    body.scale.set(1.1,1.1,2.25);rocket.add(body);
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const a=i*Math.PI/2,fin=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.09,.39,.46),metal);
      fin.position.set(Math.cos(a)*.23,Math.sin(a)*.23,.68);fin.rotation.z=a;rocket.add(fin);
    }
    const flame=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.15,.54,8),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffb04e,transparent:true,opacity:.85,depthWrite:false}));
    flame.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;flame.position.z=1.34;rocket.add(flame);
    return rocket;
  }
  // gB va desaparèixer en substituir les bales per gLight: el darrer tret
  // al general provocava ReferenceError just en començar la victòria.
  return new THREE.Mesh(shot.heavy?gHeavy:gLight,shot.heavy?mS:mW);
}

function victoryKnifeSlash(shot){
  if(shot.attack!=='knife')return null;
  const points=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=16;i++){
    const a=-1.15+2.3*i/16;
    points.push(shot.hit.clone().addScaledVector(shot.direction,Math.sin(a)*.78)
      .add(new THREE.Vector3(0,Math.cos(a)*.68-.14,0)));
  }
  const slash=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points),16,.045,5,false),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xdbe9ed,transparent:true,opacity:.82,depthWrite:false}));
  slash.visible=false;scene.add(slash);return slash;
}

function victoryReplaySound(shot){
  if(shot.attack==='knife'||shot.attack==='impact'){snd('hurt',.55);return}
  if(shot.attack==='grenade'||shot.attack==='rocket'||shot.attack==='explosion'){snd('boom',.72);return}
  victorySlowGunshot(shot.heavy);
}

function victoryClearObstructions(v){
  // La simulació s'atura quan mor el general: els fragments i el flaix
  // de l'explosió quedarien congelats davant de la càmera.
  for(const d of DB){
    const mesh=d.m;if(!mesh||v.dimmedFragments.has(mesh))continue;
    const original=mesh.material;
    const dim=material=>{
      if(!material)return material;
      if(!v.fragmentMaterials.has(material)){
        const faded=material.clone();faded.transparent=true;faded.opacity=.23;faded.depthWrite=false;
        v.fragmentMaterials.set(material,faded);
      }
      return v.fragmentMaterials.get(material);
    };
    v.dimmedFragments.set(mesh,original);
    mesh.material=Array.isArray(original)?original.map(dim):dim(original);
  }
  for(const f of fx)if(f.o&&!v.hiddenExplosionFx.has(f.o)){
    v.hiddenExplosionFx.set(f.o,f.o.visible);f.o.visible=false;
  }
}

function victorySlowGunshot(heavy){
  snd(heavy?'replayCannon':'replayShot');
}
function victoryGullCry(){audioGullCry()}
function victoryFindSea(general){
  // Cercar aigua real, no un fons inventat. Afavorim el mateix costat del sol.
  let best=null,score=-Infinity;
  const sunHeading=new THREE.Vector3(sunDir.x,0,sunDir.z).normalize();
  for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
    const a=i*Math.PI*2/24,dir=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a),0,Math.sin(a));
    let water=0;
    for(const dist of [140,260,400,600,820]){
      const x=Math.max(-H+35,Math.min(H-35,general.x+dir.x*dist)),
            z=Math.max(-H+35,Math.min(H-35,general.z+dir.z*dist));
      if(hAt(x,z)<-.9)water+=1;
    }
    const rank=water*3+dir.dot(sunHeading)*2;
    if(rank>score){score=rank;best=dir}
  }
  return best||sunHeading;
}
function victoryUi(show){
  const ids=['hud','mm','perfStats','contextButtons','joystick','strafeLeft',
    'strafeRight','sniperScope'],c=victoryCinematic;
  if(!c)return;
  if(show){
    for(const id of ids){
      const node=document.getElementById(id);
      c.originalVisibility[id]=node.style.visibility;
      node.style.visibility='hidden';
    }
  }else for(const id of ids)
    document.getElementById(id).style.visibility=c.originalVisibility[id]||'';
}
function clearVictoryCinematic(){
  const v=victoryCinematic;if(!v)return;
  victoryUi(false);
  if(v.pose)window.HUNTER_VICTORY_POSE.apply(v.pose,0);
  if(v.bullet)scene.remove(v.bullet);
  if(v.knifeSlash){scene.remove(v.knifeSlash);v.knifeSlash.geometry.dispose();v.knifeSlash.material.dispose()}
  if(v.impactFlash)scene.remove(v.impactFlash);
  for(const [mesh,material] of v.dimmedFragments)mesh.material=material;
